newsitem.title: USA: RDO Equipment completes Sun Valley purchase.
newsitem.headline: RDO Equipment completes Sun Valley purchase.

text.p: RDO Equipment Co said Monday its new subsidiary, RDO Rental, completed its previously announced acquisition of Sun Valley Equipment Corp of Cottonwood, Arizona, for an undisclosed price.
A company spokesman said the company will operate under the Sun Valley Equipment name. Sun Valley posted annual revenues of $8.1 million in 1996, RDO Equipment said.
RDO Equipment owns and operates an industrial and agricultural equipment dealership through a network of 37 stores in seven states.
Its shares closed unchanged Monday at 16.
